latest_release.body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at main -->

## What's Changed
* Prefetch bottle attestations in bulk by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24436
* Correct documentation and JSON help by @hezhizhen in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24437
* Fix shared documentation lint edge cases by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24443
* Explain denied Landlock root directory listings by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24448
* Require `zap` stanzas in all official casks by @bevanjkay in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24435
* Verify backfilled :all bottle subjects by @hezhizhen in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24447
* Harden MCP server schemas and argument handling by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24453
* livecheck: make throttle rate and days mutually exclusive by @cho-m in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24451
* Add explicit package source loading APIs by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24438
* create: Audit fix - skip version if it is present in URL by @abitrolly in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24385
* Skip `id` forks for read-only brew commands by @bvolpato in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24455
* workflows/tests: audit homebrew/cask on Linux by @bevanjkay in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24434
* Migrate formula callers to explicit source APIs by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24439
* Migrate cask callers to explicit source APIs by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24441
* Explain root command and service ownership trust by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24457
* ISSUE_TEMPLATE.md: remove retired template by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24459
* Document and update the Security Team by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24461
* Read curl headers from stdin with curl 7.55+ by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24464
* info: mark formulae removed from their tap by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24462
* Allow updating PyPI resources when bumping non-PyPI formula by @cho-m in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24463
* Measure maintainer access used to help others by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24456
* Make sponsor ordering deterministic by @ZhongRuoyu in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24468
* doctor: skip removed formulae in unlinked check by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24466
* bundle: add a `pin: true` Brewfile option by @zhuoqun-chen in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24454
* cleanup: remove old kegs of outdated formulae by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24465
* docs: Add ToC to Language Specific Formulae by @abitrolly in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24473
* vendor-gems: limit dispatches to brew branches by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24478
* Expand language-specific formula guidance by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24479
* Audit GoReleaser flags in staged resources by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24481
* rubocops/components_redundancy: drop bottle audit by @cho-m in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24487
* Apply the command name check to external lookups by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24483
* livecheck/strategy/crate: use sparse index by @cho-m in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24449
* Allow untapping untrusted formula taps by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24477
* unpack: verify cached cask checksums by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24480
* diagnostic: fix spacing around warnings by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24485
* Validate MCP help topics before dispatch by @MikeM

detail.readme: # 🍺 Homebrew [![Latest GitHub release](https://img.shields.io/github/release/Homebrew/brew.svg)](https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/releases) [![BSD-2-Clause License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/Homebrew/brew)](https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/blob/HEAD/LICENSE.txt) [![GitHub Sponsors](https://img.shields.io/github/sponsors/homebrew?label=GitHub%20Sponsors)](https://github.com/sponsors/Homebrew) [![Open Collective backers and sponsors](https://img.shields.io/opencollective/all/homebrew?label=Open%20Collective)](https://opencollective.com/homebrew) See [Homebrew's homepage at `brew.sh`](https://brew.sh) for installation instructions, what homebrew does, packages, `brew bundle` and more. ## 💸 Donations Homebrew is a non-profit project run entirely by volunteers, not employees. We need your funds to pay for software, hardware and hosting around continuous integration and future improvements to the project. Every donation will be spent on making Homebrew better for our users. Please consider a regular donation through [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/Homebrew), [Open Collective](https://opencollective.com/homebrew) or [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/homebrew). Read about [sponsoring Homebrew](https://docs.brew.sh/Sponsoring-Homebrew). Homebrew is fiscally hosted by the [Open Source Collective](https://opencollective.com/opensource). ## 📚 Documentation Read the Homebrew manual with [`man brew`](https://docs.brew.sh/Manpage). Read [installation](https://docs.brew.sh/Installation), [troubleshooting](https://docs.brew.sh/Troubleshooting), [contribution](https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/blob/HEAD/docs/How-To-Open-a-Homebrew-Pull-Request.md) including the [FAQ](https://docs.brew.sh/FAQ) on [`docs.brew.sh`](https://docs.brew.sh/). Read the [Homebrew Blog](https://brew.sh/blog/) for release notes, project updates and announcements. ## 📦 Packages Find [formulae](https://formulae.brew.sh/formula/), [casks](https://formulae.brew.sh/cask/), dependencies, versions and package metadata on [`formulae.brew.sh`](https://formulae.brew.sh). View anonymised install, build and operating system usage data at [`formulae.brew.sh/analytics`](https://formulae.brew.sh/analytics/). Read how Homebrew uses [Anonymous Analytics](https://docs.brew.sh/Analytics). ## 🔧 Get Help First, please run `brew update` and run (and **read**) `brew doctor`. Second, read the [Troubleshooting Checklist](https://docs.brew.sh/Troubleshooting). **If you don't read these it will take us far longer to help you with your problem.** After this, if you still need help, please ask in [Homebrew/discussions](https://github.com/orgs/Homebrew/discussions) or follow (and **read**) the [Homebrew/brew new issue chooser](https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/issues/new/choose). ## 💬 Social Follow Homebrew on [Mastodon](https://fosstodon.org/@homebrew), [Bluesky](https://bsky.app/profile/brew.sh), [𝕏 (Twitter)](https://x.com/MacHomebrew) or subscribe to the [newsletter](https://buttondown.email/homebrew). ## 🤝 Contributing We'd love you to join us and >10,000 others by contributing to Homebrew! First, please read our [Contribution Guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) and [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/Homebrew/.github/blob/HEAD/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md#code-of-conduct). A good starting point for contributing is: - `brew tap --force homebrew/core` or `brew tap --force homebrew/cask` (depending on whether you'd rather work on formulae or casks) - perform a strict audit on a package you use e.g. `brew audit --strict ffmpeg` for FFmpeg - if no warnings, run `brew audit --strict` to run on all packages and pick one to fix - read through the warnings and fix them until `brew audit --strict ` shows no results - [submit a pull request](https://docs.brew.sh/How-To-Open-a-Homebrew-Pull-Request) with your fixes Alternatively, for something more substantial, check out one of the open issues in [Homebrew/brew](https://github.com/homebrew/brew/issues), [Homebrew/homebrew-core](https://github.com/homebrew/homebrew-core/issues) or [Homebrew/homebrew-cask](https://github.com/homebrew/homebrew-cask/issues). If you've had inspiration for a new feature or bug fix: we don't need you to open an issue first, just [open a pull request](https://docs.brew.sh/How-To-Open-a-Homebrew-Pull-Request) with your implementation and we'll review it. Good luck! ## 🔐 Security Please see [our security policy](https://github.com/Homebrew/.github/blob/HEAD/SECURITY.md) for how to report security issues and what is in scope. ## 👥 Who We Are Homebrew's [Project Leader](https://docs.brew.sh/Homebrew-Governance#project-leader) is [Mike McQuaid](https://github.com/MikeMcQuaid). Homebrew's [Lead Maintainers](https://docs.brew.sh/Homebrew-Governance#lead-maintainer) are [Bevan Kay](https://github.com/bevanjkay), [Carlo Cabrera](https://github.com/carlocab), [Justin Krehel](https://github.com/krehel), [Michael Cho](https://github.com/cho-m), [Mike McQuaid](https://github.com/MikeMcQuaid), [Nanda H Krishna](https://github.com/nandahkrishna), [Patrick Linnane](https://github.com/p-linnane), [Rui Chen](https://github.com/chenrui333), [Ruoyu Zhong](https://github.com/ZhongRuoyu), [Sam Ford](https://github.com/samford) and [Sean Molenaar](https://github.com/SMillerDev). Homebrew's [Security Team](https://docs.brew.sh/Homebrew-Governance#4-security--emergency-actions) members are [Andrew Nesbitt](https://github.com/andrew), [Mike McQuaid](https://github.com/MikeMcQuaid), [Patrick Linnane](https://github.com/p-linnane) and [William Woodruff](https://github.com/woodruffw). Homebrew's other Maintainers are [Andrew Nesbitt](https://github.com/andrew), [Anton Melnikov](https://github.com/botantony), [Bo Anderson](https://github.com/Bo98), [Branch Vincent](https://github.com/branchv), [Caleb Xu](https://github.com/alebcay), [Daeho Ro](https://github.com/daeho-ro), [Douglas Eichelberger](https://github.com/dduugg), [Dustin Rodrigues](https://github.com/dtrodrigues), [FX Coudert](https://github.com/fxcoudert), [Harald Nordgren](https://github.com/HaraldNordgren), [Issy Long](https://github.com/issyl0), [Klaus Hipp](https://github.com/khipp), [Markus Reiter](https://github.com/reitermarkus), [Michka Popoff](https://github.com/iMichka), [Štefan Baebler](https://github.com/stefanb), [Thierry Moisan](https://github.com/Moisan) and [William Woodruff](https://github.com/woodruffw). Homebrew was originally created by [Max Howell](https://github.com/mxcl). ## 📜 License Code is under the [BSD 2-clause "Simplified" License](LICENSE.txt).
